page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No notes in the margins, no footnotes, no catchword or signature. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.l: Iesuiticum. Si quem enim non duraturum
suspicantur in propofito, aut erupturum, aut
mentis, enecant. Nihil ipsis affingo. Scribo
quod res est. Fuit Græcii ante bien-
cum se profugiturum, & quæ prætereà in se
parunt ex quo postea nunquam emersisse
stantiis, quod ipse miser Clussæus facturus
erat, ego divulgabo. Quin & aliud huic
non dissimile facinus in Martinum quen-

page.notes: Start of page is a fragment: "lorum" is cut off at the left edge, probably the end of a word like "illorum" or "eorum"; read as uncertain. Printed "Clussæus" and "Græcii" read with ligatures as best as possible. Last word "pa-" is broken at the page end and continues on the next page.
